subject.title: Manage Claw cron jobs through the gateway

question: Should OpenClaw accept Gateway-owned Claw cron lifecycle and durable cron provenance as part of the experimental core Claws stack, or keep the stack paused pending RFC sponsorship and integration sequencing?
rationale: The implementation adds a new experimental core CLI and persisted lifecycle contract across a stack of unmerged PRs; test success cannot determine whether that product boundary should land.

options.title: Sponsor the cron slice after proof
options.body: Confirm the experimental core direction, then require redacted real-Gateway proof on the exact head before merging this stacked prerequisite.

options.title: Pause the core Claws stack
options.body: Keep the PR open but defer merging until the RFC and the preceding export/lifecycle slices have an explicit maintainer-approved landing plan.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the cron slice after proof
recommendation.body: Confirm the experimental core direction, then require redacted real-Gateway proof on the exact head before merging this stacked prerequisite.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned to the PR and previously specified the relevant lifecycle and ownership invariants.
